newsitem.title: USA: USDA buys 7.36 mln lbs frozen beef for programs.
newsitem.headline: USDA buys 7.36 mln lbs frozen beef for programs.

text.p: The Agricultural Marketing Service of the U.S. Department of Agriculture said it bought approximately 7,365,600 lbs of beef products for use in the National School Lunch Program and other federal programs.
Details of the purchase are as follows:
Total purchases since the program was announced May 17:
The latest award under Announcement LS-48, Invitation 019, will be shipped between November 27 and December 10, 1996.

Winning bidders for the fine frozen ground beef were Barrios Distributing (Ocala FL) 158,400 lbs, Bauer Meat Co (Ocala FL) 198,000 lbs, Emmpak Foods Inc (Milwaukee WI) 792,000, Fresno Meat Co (Fresno CA) 792,000 lbs, Northern States Beef (Omaha NE) 79,200 lbs, Supreme Beef Processors (Dallas TX) 2,336,400 lbs, and Taylor Packing Co (Wyalusing PA) 1,584,000 lbs.
Winning bidders for frozen beef patties with VPP were Bauer Meat Co 316,800 lbs, Robzens Inc (Scranton PA) 39,600 lbs, and Supreme Beef Processors (Dallas TX) 396,000 lbs.
Winning bidders for the frozen beef patties 100 percent beef were Robzens Inc (Scranton PA) 39,600 lbs and Supreme Beef Processors (Dallas TX) 435,600 lbs.
Winning bidders for the frozen beef patties (lean) was Aksarben Foods Inc (Omaha NE) 158,400 lbs and Country Platter (Wichita KS) 39,600 lbs.
